explanation: Matches the inequality of Corollary 29 in arXiv:2607.03582: planar convex body with a center of symmetry containing the origin, p>1, |K ⊕_p -K| ≤ (2Γ(1+1/q)²/Γ(1+2/q)+2)|K|. lpSum is the Wulff-shape intersection for the support function (h_K^p+h_L^p)^{1/p} of equation (4). For convex compact bodies containing 0 this is a support function, so the set agrees with the source's K ⊕_p L, and rpow is applied only to nonnegative values.
